dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a real normed vector space E, q : R → R → E and flux : E → E, requires interval integrability of every spatial slice of q, interval integrability of every temporal slice of flux composed with q, and the identity ∫_a^b q(x,t) dx − ∫_a^b q(x,s) dx = ∫_s^t [flux(q(a,τ)) − flux(q(b,τ))] dτ for every real a,b,s,t.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specializes E to R and imposes this integral conservation identity and both integrability requirements globally, including negative times and times after T.

dependency_coverage.name: AddCommMonoidWithOne.toAddMonoidWithOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the additive monoid with one structure from a commutative additive monoid with one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Helps supply the numeral one in the differentiability order.

dependency_coverage.name: AddMonoidWithOne.toOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the distinguished element one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies one in ENat for the order-one differentiability requirement.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All listed properties must hold for the same existential witnesses.

dependency_coverage.name: CommSemiring.toSemiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the semiring structure from a commutative semiring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Participates in constructing the finite differentiability index one.

dependency_coverage.name: ContDiff
dependency_coverage.meaning: A differentiability predicate indexed by WithTop ENat. At an embedded order n it requires a Taylor series up to that order. At the outer top it requires a Taylor series up to outer top whose coefficient functions of every natural-number degree are analytic on neighborhoods of every point.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Requires flux to be C¹ on R. The initial profile uses the outer top of WithTop ENat, the analytic order, so its requirement is stronger than merely C∞.

dependency_coverage.name: Continuous
dependency_coverage.meaning: Continuity of a function between the specified topological spaces.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Requires continuity on all of R of x ↦ q(x,t) separately for each t with 0 ≤ t < T.

dependency_coverage.name: DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField
dependency_coverage.meaning: Retains the normed field structure and derives nontriviality from dense norm values.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the real scalar-field structure needed by ContDiff.

dependency_coverage.name: ENat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Natural numbers with an additional top element, defined as WithTop Nat.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Distinguishes the infinite differentiability index inside ENat from the additional outer top in WithTop ENat.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Equality of two elements of the same type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses pointwise equality with an affine function in the negated clause and exact equality in the conservation identity.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification over the specified type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Asserts existence of flux, q, T, ξ, qL and qR; also binds the affine coefficients inside a negation.

dependency_coverage.name: Filter.Tendsto
dependency_coverage.meaning: The image of the source filter under the function is bounded above by the target filter in the filter order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses the two finite one-sided limits of the spatial profile at time T.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The addition operation provided by a heterogeneous addition instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Here it is real addition in a·u+b.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplication operation provided by a heterogeneous multiplication instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Here it is real multiplication in a·u.

dependency_coverage.name: InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the normed vector-space structure of an inner-product space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies R with its real normed vector-space structure for differentiability and integration.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: The non-strict order relation supplied by an order instance.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses 0 < T, t < T and qR < qL.

dependency_coverage.name: NonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoidWithOne

dependency_coverage.name: NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup

dependency_coverage.name: Not

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural-number literal using the selected instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the differentiability order one and real zero for the initial time and time inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1

dependency_coverage.name: Real.denselyNormedField

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instPreorder

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedAddCommGroup

dependency_coverage.name: Semiring.toNonAssocSemiring

dependency_coverage.name: Set.Ioi
dependency_coverage.meaning: The set of elements strictly greater than its endpoint.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Restricts the right-limit approach to ξ < x.

dependency_coverage.name: Top.top

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Selects the outer top of WithTop ENat for the initial-profile regularity.

dependency_coverage.name: UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the topology in continuity and neighborhood filters.

dependency_coverage.name: WithTop.one
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines one in WithTop α as the embedded one of α.

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The initial profile uses this outer top, triggering the analytic branch of ContDiff.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the approach filters at ξ restricted respectively to the strictly left and strictly right rays.

dependency_coverage.name: AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub

dependency_coverage.name: IntervalIntegrable

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Requires integrability between any two finite endpoints regardless of their order, for every specified spatial and temporal slice.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume

dependency_coverage.name: NormedAddCommGroup

dependency_coverage.meaning: The integral over (a,b] minus the integral over (b,a], each using the supplied restricted measure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes every integral oriented: reversing its endpoints reverses its sign, and equal endpoints give zero.

binders: There exists a flux function flux : R → R.
There exists a state function q : R → R → R, written q(x,t), with spatial argument first and temporal argument second.
There exist real numbers T, ξ, qL and qR, representing a positive time, a spatial location, a left limiting state and a right limiting state.
The witnesses occur in the order flux, q, T, ξ, qL, qR; later witnesses may be chosen depending on earlier ones. All conjuncts concern this single tuple.
The excluded affine representation existentially quantifies real coefficients a,b and universally quantifies u ∈ R.
The spatial integrability requirement universally quantifies a,b,t ∈ R. The temporal flux integrability requirement universally quantifies x,s,t ∈ R.
The conservation identity universally quantifies a,b,s,t ∈ R, with τ the temporal integration variable and x the spatial integration variable.
The continuity requirement universally quantifies t ∈ R, conditional on 0 ≤ t and t < T.
The outer-top regularity definition existentially quantifies a Taylor-series family p and universally quantifies its degree i ∈ N.
hypotheses: There are no external hypotheses or universally prescribed initial data or flux. All required properties are conjuncts inside the existential statement.
conclusions: flux is continuously differentiable on all of R.
There are no a,b ∈ R such that flux(u)=a·u+b for every u ∈ R.
For every a,b,t ∈ R, x ↦ q(x,t) is interval integrable between a and b.
For every x,s,t ∈ R, τ ↦ flux(q(x,τ)) is interval integrable between s and t.
For every a,b,s,t ∈ R, ∫_a^b q(x,t) dx − ∫_a^b q(x,s) dx = ∫_s^t [flux(q(a,τ)) − flux(q(b,τ))] dτ.

The initial profile x ↦ q(x,0) satisfies ContDiff at the outer top of WithTop ENat: it admits the specified Taylor-series family with every coefficient function analytic on neighborhoods of all real points. This is the analytic regularity condition, and in particular implies smoothness.
For every t ∈ [0,T), the function x ↦ q(x,t) is continuous on all of R.
lim_{x→ξ, x<ξ} q(x,T)=qL and lim_{x→ξ, x>ξ} q(x,T)=qR.
qR < qL, so the profile at time T has distinct finite one-sided limits forming a downward spatial jump at ξ.
mathematical_definitions: R carries its usual field operations, order, absolute-value norm and Euclidean topology.
Integrals use the canonical real volume measure, conventionally Lebesgue measure.
For real endpoints a,b, interval integrability means integrability on both (a,b] and (b,a].
The oriented integral ∫_a^b f is defined as the measure integral over (a,b] minus that over (b,a].
The left and right limits use the neighborhood filter at ξ intersected with the principal filters of (−∞,ξ) and (ξ,∞), respectively.
Non-affineness is global on the entire real state line, rather than restricted to the values attained by q.
ENat is WithTop N. Consequently, the outer top in WithTop ENat is distinct from the embedded infinite order used for ordinary C∞ regularity.
translation.proposition_plain_english: There exist a globally C¹, globally non-affine real flux function flux, a real-valued function q defined for every real space and time coordinate, a positive real time T, a real spatial point ξ, and real states qL>qR with the following simultaneous properties. Every spatial slice of q is integrable on every bounded interval, every temporal slice of flux(q) is integrable on every bounded interval, and for all real a,b,s,t the change from time s to time t of the oriented spatial integral of q from a to b equals the oriented temporal integral from s to t of flux(q(a,τ))−flux(q(b,τ)). The initial spatial profile satisfies the analytic outer-top ContDiff condition. Every spatial profile at a time 0≤t<T is continuous everywhere. At time T the left and right spatial limits at ξ exist and equal qL and qR respectively, with the right limit strictly smaller than the left.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: This is an existence assertion for one flux and one state function. It does not assert the result for every non-affine flux or for arbitrary prescribed initial data.
All spatial and temporal coordinates in the integral conservation condition range over R without endpoint-order restrictions. In particular, this condition holds before time zero and after T.
The explicit spatial regularity before T is only continuity of each fixed-time slice; no joint continuity, temporal differentiability or classical pointwise PDE is explicitly required.
The initial regularity index is outer top, which selects analytic regularity rather than merely infinitely differentiable regularity.
The assertion includes no entropy inequality, convexity or strict convexity of flux, uniqueness, shock trajectory, shock speed or explicit Rankine–Hugoniot condition.
Global non-affineness does not require the flux to be non-affine on the actual range of q.
The limit clauses do not specify q(ξ,T). Distinct one-sided limits imply discontinuity at ξ regardless of that value.
The statement requires no spatial continuity at or after T and does not exclude additional discontinuities at time T.
Integrability is on bounded intervals, not necessarily on the whole real line. No global boundedness, decay, compact support or finite total mass is required.
The temporal integrability condition applies to flux(q(x,τ)), not directly to q(x,τ). Joint measurability is not explicitly required.

Since T>0, the quantified continuity interval [0,T) is nonempty. Since ξ is real, both strict one-sided approach filters are nontrivial, so the limit requirements are not vacuous through an empty approach domain.
Degenerate intervals give trivial integral identities, but the universal quantifiers also require the identities and integrability for every nondegenerate finite interval.
ambiguities: Several external-frontier definitions are not fully expanded: in particular, nhds has an opaque wrapped projection, Real.measureSpace is shown only as inferInstance, and the ContDiff matcher and Taylor-series and analyticity predicates are not defined further. Their standard mathematical interpretations are used above; the packet alone does not expose their full foundational implementation or the construction and normalization of real volume.
